expectations.evidence: All 10 prompts analyzed individually with rating, 4-dimension scoring (Atomic specificity, Schema alignment, Anti-hallucination, Inference guidance), strengths, and issues per prompt.

Rates each prompt on Atomic Level (5/10 to 10/10) and Risk of Generic Output (Very Low to High). Identifies story origin_story, mission inference, brand_essence, and strategy prompt as generic-risk areas.

Mentions StoryBrand and Brand Love Key by name for narrative/positioning prompts, but does NOT systematically cross-reference against Aaker, Keller, Gad, or Neumeier. No framework coverage matrix. No analysis of which framework concepts are missing from which prompts.

Identifies weaknesses in story (hallucination risk, platitude missions), positioning (brand_essence platitudes), strategy (empty 80% of time), plus cross-cutting input quality gate issue. 4+ concrete weaknesses.

No evaluation of plain language vs methodology jargon mapping. The report evaluates prompt quality from a technical/engineering perspective but doesn't assess whether prompts translate marketing concepts into user-friendly language or whether internal field names map to methodology terms.
